scope: Read-only independent recomputation of sealed numeric event/output records; existing postseal EVENT_AUDIT only, no new label/pixel access, prediction or GT scoring.
official_rate_metrics_basis: Sealed official METRICS hash verified; raw GT is not reopened.

native_opportunity_coverage.definition: Exact same-segment frame or source membership; windows inclusive suspect..q. Six WRONG q are RGB identity reattachment opportunities, not six independently removable CLEAR events.
native_opportunity_coverage.limit: q470 also has source81 switching outside the pair and prior carrier1→24 damage; q1280 involves a third fish and is not a pre/post bijection. Coverage counts are not an IDF1 or possible-IDSW gain upper bound.

root_causes: Fourteen of nineteen q have zero depth edges: twelve fail paired post eligibility, two have no full numeric candidate pair. This is a measurement/fragment-qualification bottleneck before any likelihood threshold.
All fourteen unusable q post cores have n<16; thirteen also have eroded exclusive area<16. Dense filling cannot make those thirteen cores meet a sixteen-pixel minimum under the unchanged geometry.

Four scorable q have full nonzero evidence. Depth rank matches the RGB expected mapping in all four; joint rank matches three native-WRONG q but their odds remain below nine. One native-CORRECT q (1263) has weak opposing geometry/total, and native fallback avoids damage.

P2 uses no inferred post at any q: 24 retained and 14 NONE; exactly the same qualification/used-edge pattern as raw. It adds some historical samples, but the three gate-limited WRONG q still use retained histories only.

Long extrapolation and short/single histories produce scales up to hundreds of mm; these are assumed model uncertainty, not observed sensor accuracy. P1 positive-gap WRONG-q scales are 97/363,64/82,116/166 mm.
The current depth ratio compares H1 and H2 without an explicit lawful-native/no-link explanation. It cannot be interpreted as posterior evidence that a link should replace native.
interpretation_limits: RGB-polygon bank/post identity correspondence is not depth surface ownership or physical-mm ground truth.
The four reference-nonbijection q (398,434,1280,1504) each contain a post matching a third fish; they remain UNKNOWN rather than incorrect or correct.
A positive candidate rank is post hoc evidence of directional signal, not a successful staged transaction or demonstrated tracking improvement.
No lowering of nine to eight, replays, threshold sweeps, source substitution or frozen-file edits were performed.

Geometry-only rank is also reference-correct at 1390/1745/1805. Correct depth ranking in these cases does not establish independent depth value; depth-zero and effective correspondence controls are required. The only nonzero case where depth flips the geometry-best candidate is unscorable q1280.

next_frozen_experiment.name: Explicit lawful-native/null hypothesis with calibrated joint 2D/depth prediction evidence
next_frozen_experiment.hypothesis: The present measure contains directionally useful retained-depth evidence in three real native fragmentation opportunities, but a two-link-only ratio and assumed temporal uncertainty block use; a fair native/null comparison may distinguish new links without damaging valid native continuity.
next_frozen_experiment.fixed_evaluation_cohort: Keep all four SOURCE_OLD segments and all 1471 frames, masks, scanner, q first observations, own-state publication and atomic stage. Retain every event including no split, no numeric pair, failed stage and UNKNOWN. This is an exposed mechanistic comparison, not blind generalization.
next_frozen_experiment.calibration_cohort: Before new prediction, freeze source bytes and contiguous ordinary clean fragments outside these four evaluation segments where available. Eligibility is existing no-GT source/quality/contact/depth rules; no selection by the 19 q reference outcomes. If a disjoint cohort is unavailable, declare the calibration exposed and reserve new contiguous source intervals before fitting or scoring.
calibration_targets: Lag-conditioned errors between pre-only forecasts and withheld clean observed 2D center/depth proxy, separated by retained and inferred provenance.
Grouped fragment/temporal blocks rather than randomly split pixels or frames; retain missing predictions and report coverage at the original object denominator.
Include lags spanning recorded 0.3–1.4 s opportunities and long-lag tails before outcome inspection. A clean-source residual is predictive proxy consistency, not physical surface or true-mm error.

hypotheses.H0_NATIVE_NO_LINK: Complete lawful own-branch native/previous committed-alias mapping, preserving any already valid continuous links; do not pretend every continuing source is a new birth.
hypotheses.H1_H2: The two full pre-to-post bijections, with source epochs and actual bank anchors bound as in DS7.

scoring_contract: Deduplicate identical public mappings across H0/H1/H2 so an unchanged native mapping cannot win by being counted twice.

Use jointly comparable normalized observation likelihoods and explicit priors/null or birth model. A weighted sum of present geometry distance and depth contrast is a cost, not a calibrated posterior.
Handle absent evidence by the same marginal/common term in every relevant hypothesis; absent null features are not zero-cost rewards.
Keep predictions causal for P1 raw. Retain restored-v2 as a separately scoped offline branch only if it is actually studied; do not merge its RGB/future provenance into the raw claim.
controls: Same lawful H0/H1/H2 controller with depth contribution neutralized: joint-2D-only intervention control.
Same controller with calibrated raw 2D+depth evidence.

Same full-flow controller with actual post depth associations swapped/permuted while geometry/masks/times remain fixed. Freeze permutation before scoring and report effective nontrivial perturbations; a no-op shuffle is not independence evidence.
next_frozen_experiment.criterion: Predeclare the inherited pooled IDF1/HOTA/AssA strict increase and IDSW nonincrease versus native, separately from engineering pass. Report raw joint depth versus the identical depth-zero and effective depth-permutation controls; full independent replay and shared-state candidate diagnostics have distinct interpretations. Do not choose a threshold from F1745 or claim an achieved benefit from recorded ranks.
known_risks: H0 requires a genuine no-link/birth likelihood and prior; clean continuation residuals alone cannot calibrate the event/birth prior.
2D, depth, mask errors and inferred samples can be correlated. Independence or WLS information gain is an assumption until held-out residual calibration supports it.
Ordinary clean movement can differ from occlusion/contact events; successful clean calibration does not certify applicability at split q.
Three of six native fragmentation opportunities still have no qualified paired core evidence. Null modeling cannot recover absent surface measurements.

Most native switches fall outside the current two-fish q contract; a later disappearance/reappearance mechanism or independent spatial surface measurement may be needed, with its own fixed coverage census.
